resources.string: Shows CarPlay’s next turn, distance and road on the windshield head-up display while CarPlay navigation is guiding. Applies at the next turn update.
How much of the map the HUD shows. Far shows more streets, smaller; Near shows fewer, larger. Applies at the next connection.

Pulses the car\'s ambient lights to CarPlay music, using the car\'s own music mode. Turn on the ambient lights and their music sync in the car first. If anything fails, DiPlay stops and hands the lights back to the car.
Beat flashes the lights on each bass beat and fades them until the next. Rhythm raises and lowers them smoothly with the music.
Smoothness: 1 changes quickly, 5 changes slowly. Depth: how far the lights dim between beats. Beat sensitivity: 5 catches softer beats. Changes apply at once.
The car’s HUD and ambient lights. Turn any of them off here.

DiPlay draws on the windshield for your trim: the 2D HUD’s map box on Options 1 and 2, the larger AR-HUD map on Option 3. Automatic reads the trim from the car, as the car’s own navigation does; pick yours only if Automatic shows the wrong one. Applies at the next connection.
On the Mazda EZ-60 a three-finger swipe closes the app, so DiPlay uses two fingers there and does not offer three.

Shows CarPlay’s map, or the next turn when there is no map, in the AR-HUD’s own map box while CarPlay navigation is guiding and the car is out of Park. DiPlay switches the car’s HUD picture for this and gives it back when the route ends or anything fails. Do not use it while the car’s own navigation is guiding. Turning it on applies at the next connection; turning it off removes the map at once.

Largest, the default, uses the AR-HUD picture to the right of the HUD’s speed and gear, about three times the car’s own map; it is the size that read best at the glass on 100-inch AR-HUD cars. Large sits between, and the car’s size matches its own navigation map. With the map on the left, the car’s size is kept. Applies at the next connection.

The HUD projects the map’s background as a lit box. See-through fades it so you see the road through it: 0 % is the map as the iPhone draws it, 100 % removes the background. Lines only also removes parks, water and buildings, and draws roads, the route and labels brighter. Changes apply at once.
